fruits.name: Apple
fruits.description: The apple is a round fruit with crisp flesh, typically red, green, or yellow in color.

fruits.name: Orange
fruits.description: The orange is a citrus fruit known for its bright orange peel and juicy segments.

fruits.name: Banana
fruits.description: The banana is a long curved fruit with a yellow peel and soft, sweet flesh.

fruits.name: Grapes
fruits.description: Grapes are small, sweet fruits that grow in clusters on vines.
